decisions.reason: Adding a panel switch does not change the main-board decoupling requirement.
The panel switch decision does not alter the addressable-LED supply, switching GPIO, or level-shifting rules.
The switch is required, but the source does not establish whether it is an onboard component or requires an additional JST connector destination.
The added switch does not change standalone USB power activation, capacity, or powered scope.
The source adds a switch but specifies no GPIO assignment and does not change any existing GPIO mapping.
The panel switch does not change the INA219 or the monitored 3.3V rail.
The panel switch decision does not alter power-source OR-ing or source-selection behavior.
The switch requirement is unrelated to I2C series-resistor population, purpose, and topology.
The panel switch does not change the battery-charge status output or its connector and resistor configuration.
The source does not change either interboard connector, its pinout, or the matching-numbering policy.
The main-board panel switch has no effect on power-board battery protection.
The source concerns a main-board panel control and does not change the power-board mechanical layout.
